name: Smooth data mapped to cortical surface
summary: Smooths every surface measure in a cortexmap with Connectome Workbench wb_command -metric-smoothing on the white surface, adding smoothed copies alongside the originals.
description: For each func file in the cortexmap, writes a smoothed copy (<name>.smooth_<kernel>.func.gii) computed on that hemisphere's white surface with the chosen kernel and method; the original files are kept. Use it to reduce noise before group analysis. The cortexmap must contain lh/rh.white.surf.gii.

inputs.description: cortexmap whose func metrics are smoothed.
inputs.requirements: Must contain lh.white.surf.gii and rh.white.surf.gii in surf/.

outputs.description: The input cortexmap plus smoothed copies of every func metric (*.smooth_<kernel>.func.gii).

parameters.description: Smoothing kernel passed to wb_command -metric-smoothing; interpreted as a Gaussian sigma unless surface_fwhm is true, then as FWHM.
if you want to treat zeros as not being data, set as true
If you want to treat "surface_smooth_kernel" as a fwhm instead of sigma, set to true
